resources.string: Off: the app keeps a connection
Your server sends its notices to Google\'s push service, and your phone takes them from there. The app then needs no permanent connection and no entry in the status bar for this account.
Google sees when a message comes and how big it is, never what is in it.

A notification that goes away when you read the mail elsewhere, and calendar reminders, can be late while the phone is idle: the server sends those without urgency. Reminders are not yet scheduled on the phone itself.
If you force-stop the app in the system settings, nothing arrives until you open it again.
The app keeps a connection to your server again and shows its quiet entry in the status bar. Push through Google is switched off for this account.
Push through Google is on for this account.
